polishes.name: At Your Serviceberry
polishes.description: Monarch is a soft semi-sheer peachy polish warmed with a kiss of orange/gold/lime shifting shimmer. All swatches are shown in 2-3 coats of polish and topped with FFL's True Tranquility QDTC or Mindfulness Matte-rs Top Coat. Swatches: @polishandpups, @nub.luv, @nails.and.hamer, @j_adorelife, @that.lacquer.girl, @sheislisab, & @ronitadasgupta77 Hand-poured in our full-size 15mL square-shaped bottle and includes 2 stainless steel mixing beads.

polishes.name: Canopy Quick Dry Top Coat
polishes.finish: Magnetic, Reflective, Holographic, Glitter, Shimmer, Jelly, Topper
polishes.description: Glossy, quick-dry top coat for a smooth, long-lasting finish. Seals in color with a high-shine, glassy finish while helping to smooth the surface and extend wear. Quick-drying and self-leveling for an even, durable finish that enhances depth and protects against chips.

polishes.name: Got Milkweed?
polishes.description: A soft raspberry pink jelly packed with pink holographic glitter, a scattering of silver reflective and pink hex glitters, and a subtle pink-violet shimmer. Builds to full coverage in 2-3 coats. It can be used as a topper, but due to the density of glitter, is best applied in one very light coat when the polish underneath is fully dry. (Hint: try it over The Fixer!) Got Milkweed? is inspired by the mighty milkweed. Best known as the sole host plant for Monarch butterflies, there are more than 70 varieties native to North America, ranging in color from the delicate creams and pinks to vibrant fuchsias, and they support more than 450 species of insect. Its rich nectar is a magnet for pollinators, which in turn provide a valuable food source for birds as well. $1 of every polish sold will be donated to The Nature Conservancy

polishes.name: Grudge
polishes.description: Blackened purple jelly base with blue-to-cyan-purple shifting shimmer. Grudge is a deep, moody purple filled with a glowing aurora shimmer that shifts between blue, cyan, and purple in different lighting. Inspired by the enigmatic American crow and their remarkable memory for those who've wronged them, Grudge is a striking reminder that some things may be forgiven, but they're never forgotten. Full coverage in 2 coats for most nail lengths. *Swatches by @olive_nail_polish and @ihavethisthingwithpolish shown in two coats over Understory Priming Base Coat.

polishes.name: It's a Trap
polishes.finish: Reflective, Iridescent, Holographic, Multichrome, Glitter, Shimmer, Jelly, Sheer, Topper, Top Coat, Base Coat
polishes.description: It's a Trap! is a deep navy jelly base with glowing violet shimmer that shifts to red. This polish is inspired by Tacca chantrieri, commonly known as the black bat flower, for its unique appearance resembling a bat in flight. The bat flower emits a foul odor that attracts pollinators, then traps them in its maze-like structures, leaving it to rely on self-pollination to reproduce.

polishes.name: Metamorphosis
polishes.collection: and was the inspiration for creating the Flighty by Nature charity
polishes.description: Sheer jelly base with silver and blue reflective glitters, silver holo glitter, and a blue-to-indigo aurora shimmer. Inspired by the Karner Blue butterfly and its iridescent wings that shift from soft grays and blues to purple hues. Designed for versatility, Metamorphosis can be worn on its own as a sheer wash of light-shifting shimmer or used as a topper over other colors. Because of the sheerness, a blurring base coat is recommended to minimize visible nail line when worn on its own. Due to the glitter, it will dry down slightly textured, so be sure to use a top coat to restore a smooth and shiny finish. *Swatches by @olive_nail_polish, @ihavethisthingwithpolish, and opposum_claw shown over Understory Priming Base Coat. *Swatches by @olive_nail_polish shown in three coats over Understory Priming Base Coat. $1 of each polish sold will be donated to the non-profit Xerces Society for Invertebrate Conservation. The Karner Blue butterfly is listed as an endangered species, and was the inspiration for creating the Flighty by Nature charity collection. Habitat loss, pesticides, and climate change are affecting invertebrates at alarming rates, with populations declining globally by nearly 10% every decade.

polishes.name: Not Tonight
polishes.description: Hot pink jelly base with pink-to-orange-to-violet shimmer. Inspired by the iridescent hues of the roseate skimmer dragonfly, this bold, color-shifting pink is guaranteed to make a splash at the pond.The name comes from a study where female dragonflies were caught in the act of faking their own deaths just to dodge the advances of overly persistent suitors. While playing dead to trick a predator is a classic animal move, playing dead to avoid an awkward date is next-level drama, seen in only a handful of species. Buildable in 1–2 coats. *Swatches by @olive_nail_polish and @ihavethisthingwithpolish shown in two coats over Understory Priming Base Coat. $1 of each polish sold will be donated to the non-profit Xerces Society for Invertebrate Conservation.

polishes.name: One in a Vermillion
polishes.description: Bright true red with red-to-orange-to-gold shifting shimmer. One in a Vermillion captures the striking coloring and aerial acrobatics of the vermilion flycatcher in a high-energy red with almost as much attitude as the bird that inspired it. Buildable in 2–3 coats. *Swatches by @olive_nail_polish and @ihavethisthingwithpolish shown in two coats over Understory Priming Base Coat.

polishes.name: Paralytic
polishes.finish: Holographic, Glitter, Shimmer, Jelly, Top Coat, Base Coat
polishes.description: Cobalt blue base with subtle indigo shifts and an electric blue-to-cyan shimmer. This polish delivers bold color, a smooth finish, and shimmer that comes to life in direct light. Inspired by the blue mud dauber wasp, which paralyzes prey with its venom, just one coat of this color will have you in its clutches. Buildable in 1–2 coats. *Swatches by @olive_nail_polish and @ihavethisthingwithpolish shown in two coats over Understory Priming Base Coat. $1 of each polish sold will be donated to the non-profit Xerces Society for Invertebrate Conservation

polishes.name: Pest Friends
polishes.description: Teal blue jelly with teal and silver holo glitter, and a soft blue-purple shimmer. Pest Friends is a glittering tribute to the black-billed magpie that lights up with holographic sparkle in direct light, and shows off its subtle side, with subtle blue-purple shifts, in indirect light. Black-billed magpies may ruffle feathers with their noisy antics, but to deer they’re heroic “pest friends”. By landing on the deer to eat their ticks, magpies help slow the spread of tick-borne illness and score a tasty snack. This polish dries textured due to the glitter, but a regular top coat will smooth it out. For extra "plumping" a glitter grabber or second coat of top coat is recommended. *Swatches by @olive_nail_polish, @ihavethisthingwithpolish, and opposum_claw shown over Understory Priming Base Coat.

polishes.name: Sage Against the Machine
polishes.description: Semi-sheer grungy sage green base with a luminous blue-to-silver shimmer. With a smooth, silvery-blue finish and a buildable sage green base, Sage Against the Machine pays homage to the silver sagebrush of the American West, a resilient plant that adapts to defend itself and thrive in the harshest conditions. Buildable in 2–3 coats. *Swatches by @olive_nail_polish, @ihavethisthingwithpolish, and opposum_claw shown over Understory Priming Base Coat. This polish is semi-sheer, a blurring base coat is recommended for full opacity.

polishes.name: Salty!
polishes.description: A sea-green base with cool blue undertones and a vibrant green-to-gold shimmer. Inspired by the dazzling Halictidae family of native bees, better known as “sweat bees, this shimmering shade captures the metallic green of these tiny, friendly pollinators. These docile ground-nesting bees are famous for their favorite salty snack: human sweat! Buildable in 2–3 coats. *Swatches by @olive_nail_polish, @ihavethisthingwithpolish, and opposum_claw shown over Understory Priming Base Coat. $1 of each polish sold will be donated to the non-profit Xerces Society for Invertebrate Conservation.

polishes.name: Scavenger Hunt
polishes.description: Scavenger Hunt is a black jelly base with a strong green shimmer that shifts to red-purple in extreme angles. This polish is inspired by the giant water scavenger beetle, one of the largest aquatic beetles in North America. Although adults will scavenge decaying matter, the larvae are voracious predators, crushing and consuming their prey with pincher-like jaws.

polishes.name: The Fast and the Furious
polishes.description: Rich, warm violet base with shifts to a cooler indigo, packed with red-pink and blue-violet shimmer. Inspired by a tiny tyrant of the American Southwest, the Lucifer hummingbird, The Fast and the Furious provides bold color and high-impact shimmer that's as fierce as the bird itself. Buildable in 1–2 coats. *Swatches by @olive_nail_polish and @ihavethisthingwithpolish shown in two coats over Understory Priming Base Coat.

polishes.name: The Fixer
polishes.description: A neutral mid-tone purple with golden shimmer that adds a soft glow in lower lighting, and more pronounced, silver-leaning shimmer in bright direct light. The formula builds to full coverage in 2-3 coats for most nail lengths. The Fixer is inspired by leadplant, a hardy prairie shrub with purple blooms and stalks tipped with bronze as the plant ages. With taproots that can reach 15 feet deep, leadplant is an ecosystem powerhouse- providing food in the form of pollen, nectar, foliage, and seeds. As a bonus, it "fixes" soil by pulling nitrogen from the air and converting it to a fertilizer for other plants with the aid of the bacteria that live in its extensive root system.

polishes.name: Understory Priming Base Coat
polishes.description: Tinted ridge-filling base coat with a soft blurring effect. This PVB-free priming base coat smooths the nail surface, improves polish wear, and provides a subtle tint that lightly blurs stains and other imperfections. Ideal under sheer or buildable polishes, it reduces visible nail line while allowing color to build evenly. It can also be worn alone in 2 coats to enhance the look of your natural nails. Like its namesake, it supports and enhances everything layered above it.

polishes.name: Wild at Heart
polishes.description: A bright bubblegum-pink base with a cool blue-cyan aurora shimmer. Wild at Heart is inspired by the resilient wild prairie rose, a flower whose delicate beauty belies its strength. Unlike its ornamental cousins, the prairie rose thrives where others wilt, capable of surviving even fire and drought. This polish is a tribute to all of nature's unstoppable spirits. Buildable in 1–2 coats. *Swatches by @olive_nail_polish and @ihavethisthingwithpolish shown in two coats over Understory Priming Base Coat.

polishes.name: You're so Vervain
polishes.description: A cool-toned lavender base with pink-to-violet aurora shimmer. This blue-leaning lavender polish shimmers with pink and violet aurora that shifts with the light. Inspired by the versatile and vibrant vervain plant, celebrated by gardeners for its spectrum of hues from blue to purple to pink, this shade is a tribute to unapologetic confidence. Buildable in 2–3 coats. *Swatches by @olive_nail_polish and @ihavethisthingwithpolish shown in two coats over Understory Priming Base Coat.
